common.metaDescription: Rashfa café: collect your visits, unlock a mystery gift, and catch a slow-afternoon treat.
common.errorGeneric: Something slipped. Please try again in a moment.
common.notFoundBody: Let's bring you back to a familiar seat.

landing.title: Welcome to Rashfa
landing.intro: A small café for slow moments. Show your card when you visit, and now and then we'll keep a little surprise for you.
landing.step1: Show your personal code at the counter.
landing.step2: Choose: a little treat today, or save it for later.
landing.step3: Save a few times and a mystery gift opens for you.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.intro: We keep only what we need to recognise you at the counter and keep your gifts. Nothing more.
privacy.collect: Your phone number (to log in), your first name, your birthday if you choose to share it, your visits and the gifts you receive, and your notification settings.
privacy.why: To count your visits, prepare your gifts, and, only if you agree, send you a few gentle notifications (never more than a couple a week, and never at night).
privacy.share: Only the Rashfa team. We never sell or share your data. It is stored with our hosting providers (Supabase, Vercel) and sent by SMS only for your login code.
privacy.rights: Under Moroccan Law 09-08, you can access, correct or delete your data at any time. You can delete your account yourself from Settings; everything personal is erased at once.
privacy.contact: Ask us at the counter, or write to us at the address shown in the café.

join.title: Your Rashfa card
join.subtitle: Less than a minute, and your seat is saved.
join.phoneHint: We'll send you a 6-digit code by SMS. Nothing else.
join.referredBy: A friend invited you. You'll both get a little bonus after your first visit.
join.birthdayHint: Just so we can keep a small gift for you on the day.
join.consent: I agree that Rashfa keeps my first name, number and visits to run my loyalty card.
join.smsBody: Rashfa: your code is {code}. It stays valid for 10 minutes.

errors.invalidPhone: This number doesn't look right. Try 06 12 34 56 78.
errors.tooMany: That's a lot of codes. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.smsFailed: We couldn't send the SMS right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.invalidCode: That code doesn't match. Check the SMS and try again.
errors.expiredCode: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.invalidName: Please tell us your first name.
errors.consentRequired: Please tick the box so we can keep your card.

welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.giftWaiting: A small welcome gift is waiting for you. It opens tomorrow, so come back soon.
welcome.installTitle: Keep Rashfa on your home screen

install.why: Like an app, without the store. Your card is always one tap away.
install.installed: Rashfa is on your home screen. Lovely.
install.iosStep1: Tap the share button <icon></icon> at the bottom of Safari.
install.iosStep2: Scroll and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStep3: Tap “Add”, then open Rashfa from your home screen.
install.androidStep1: Open the browser menu (⋮ at the top right).
install.androidStep2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

notify.why: Now and then we'd like to tell you when a gift is ready or a quiet afternoon has a little treat.
notify.promise1: Never more than a couple a week.
notify.on: Notifications are on. We'll keep them rare.
notify.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. You can allow them there whenever you like.
notify.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone, add Rashfa to your home screen first, then open it from there to turn on notifications.
notify.unsupported: This browser can't receive notifications. Your card works perfectly without them.
